summary: Deep, selective EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata read and write — geotagging, copyright tagging, rename by capture date, and metadata export.

recipes.label: Remove GPS Location
recipes.description: Strip only GPS location data from every image in a folder, leaving other metadata (camera info, date, copyright) intact.
recipes.template: exiftool -overwrite_original -gps:all= -ext jpg -ext jpeg -ext png -ext gif -ext bmp -ext tif -ext tiff -ext heic -ext heif -ext webp {sourceFolder}

recipes.label: Remove GPS Location (Single File)
recipes.description: Strip only GPS location data from one image file, leaving other metadata (camera info, date, copyright) intact.

recipes.label: Rename by Capture Date
recipes.description: Rename every image in a folder to its original capture date/time. Files with an identical timestamp get a numeric suffix instead of colliding.
recipes.template: exiftool "-FileName<DateTimeOriginal" -d "%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S%%-c.%%e" -ext jpg -ext jpeg -ext png -ext gif -ext bmp -ext tif -ext tiff -ext heic -ext heif -ext webp {sourceFolder}

recipes.label: Rename by Capture Date (Single File)
recipes.description: Rename one image file to its original capture date/time.

recipes.label: Add Copyright & Author
recipes.description: Tag every image in a folder with an author name and copyright notice.
recipes.template: exiftool -overwrite_original -Artist={artist} -Copyright={copyright} -ext jpg -ext jpeg -ext png -ext gif -ext bmp -ext tif -ext tiff -ext heic -ext heif -ext webp {sourceFolder}

recipes.label: Add Copyright & Author (Single File)
recipes.description: Tag one image file with an author name and copyright notice.

recipes.label: Add GPS Location
recipes.description: Tag every image in a folder with a GPS coordinate (decimal degrees; use a negative value for South/West).
recipes.template: exiftool -overwrite_original -GPSLatitude={latitude} -GPSLongitude={longitude} -GPSLatitudeRef={latitude} -GPSLongitudeRef={longitude} -ext jpg -ext jpeg -ext png -ext gif -ext bmp -ext tif -ext tiff -ext heic -ext heif -ext webp {sourceFolder}

recipes.label: Add GPS Location (Single File)
recipes.description: Tag one image file with a GPS coordinate (decimal degrees; use a negative value for South/West).

recipes.label: Export Metadata to CSV
recipes.description: Read all metadata from every image in a folder and export it as a single CSV file for review or spreadsheet use.
recipes.template: exiftool -csv -ext jpg -ext jpeg -ext png -ext gif -ext bmp -ext tif -ext tiff -ext heic -ext heif -ext webp {sourceFolder} > {destination}/metadata.csv

availableOptions.label: Set Keyword
availableOptions.description: Add or set a keyword tag.

availableOptions.label: Set GPS Latitude
availableOptions.description: Set the GPS latitude in decimal degrees (negative = South); also sets the hemisphere reference.

availableOptions.label: Set GPS Longitude
availableOptions.description: Set the GPS longitude in decimal degrees (negative = West); also sets the hemisphere reference.

availableOptions.label: Overwrite Original
availableOptions.description: Don't keep an _original backup copy of edited files.

availableOptions.label: Remove All Metadata
availableOptions.description: Strip every metadata tag from the file.

availableOptions.label: Export as CSV
availableOptions.description: Output all matched metadata as CSV instead of the default format.

availableOptions.label: Export as JSON
availableOptions.description: Output all matched metadata as JSON instead of the default format.
